notes.subject: Kristy call notes / Salmon River Chamber history
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes connect White Bird Days/Hot Summer Nights with Jeannie at Salmon River Chamber, 208-305-8052, and say called/sent email with information. Gmail shows the Chamber replied in May 2026 that its town is about 400 people and its biggest event draws about 1,000, mostly adults, so they could not recoup a normal package cost. Adventure Zone offered pay-for-play as an alternative. Source: handwritten call notes pages 115/68; Adventure Zone Gmail; current Salmon River Chamber event listing.
